content:
The audit report generation failed because the Word summary document did not include the required high-priority facility-session identifiers.
The run failed with a reward of 0.00 due to an AssertionError in test_word_summary_content. While the script successfully generated the OUTPUT_DOCX file, the verifier found that 'mentioned >= 2' failed with 'assert 0 >= 2'. Specifically, the Word summary failed to mention at least two high-priority facility-session combinations (e.g., 'FAC-SESS' format) derived from the audit data. Avoid omitting specific session identifiers in the narrative summary; ensure the logic correctly identifies and writes the top 4 sessions by variance to the .docx file.
